title: Check for a heist command name collision on Windows
description: For the owner, on the Windows machine. If another program called heist is on the PATH, typing heist may start that one instead of this tool. The check takes a minute.
why: Another program named heist on PATH would shadow the CLI.

acceptance.text: where heist shows only this package

todos.text: Expected: only paths that belong to this package (the pnpm global folder or this repository)
If another path is listed, copy the output into the chat
